rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip code, reviewed relevant orders and product details, and performed correct, allowable actions: it updated the shipping address for the pending order, modified the silicone watch to a metal/white variant with an appropriate refund, and requested an exchange for the delivered air purifier to a large HEPA unit with night mode and the proper price difference. However, the agent violated a key policy requirement by executing order-changing writes without explicit confirmation in two instances: (1) it updated the address on order #W6729841 without first restating the exact change and obtaining user confirmation, and (2) it submitted the exchange request for the delivered air purifier on order #W3445693 without prior explicit confirmation of the exact change and charge. The watch modification did include explicit confirmation and was handled correctly. Because of the missing confirmations before two writes, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
